preconditions.description: The number of strings k is at least 1 and at most 2500.
The length of each string n is at least 2 and at most 5000.
The total length of the strings does not exceed 5000.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 or (output is str and len(output) == n)
postconditions.description: The output is either a string of length n or -1 if no such string exists.

postconditions.expression: output != -1 ==> all(s_i in output for s_i in s_1, s_2, ..., s_k) and is_swappable(output, s_1, s_2, ..., s_k)
postconditions.description: If the output is not -1, it must contain all characters from the given strings and must be possible to obtain the given strings by swapping exactly two characters in the output string.

postconditions.expression: output == -1 ==> not is_swappable(None, s_1, s_2, ..., s_k)
postconditions.description: If the output is -1, it means that there is no string that can be obtained by swapping exactly two characters in the given strings.
